text.title: Gauntlet of Iron
text.body: A brutal canyon kill-zone bars the Infernal Citadel's outer approach. Smash the First Gate, cross the scorching Crossfire Pit under boiling pitch fire and heavy quarrel volleys, storm the Iron Bridge, and cut down the Gauntlet Commander.
text.obj.1: Survive and clear the Crossfire Pit
text.obj.2: Force the Iron Bridge and slay the Gauntlet Commander
text.msg.1: Keep tower shields locked over your arcanists—white-hot quarrels and boiling pitch rain down across every step of this canyon!
text.msg.2: The First Gate splinters! Sifted from the guardpost is a strongbox of three hundred and fifty silver crowns.
text.msg.3: Crossfire Pit! Elevated mortar bastions and war-golems open up from the rim!
text.msg.4: The Crossfire Pit falls quiet. Silence the bridge guard and press across the Iron Bridge!
text.msg.5: The Gauntlet Commander tumbles into the slag trench! The Citadel's outer courtyard lies open!
text.win: You have broken through the Gauntlet of Iron to the foot of the Outer Rampart.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell inside the Gauntlet of Iron.
